answer: A bank of pre-written answers as a result has nothing to key against, and filling 195 aliases means authoring 195 texts that each match their own nonce. Because the derivation is bound to the violet signature, the echo gate rejects a mismatch, and the lotus checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 78 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
